_comment: The base every shard of the mutation lane derives from (harness/src/mutation.ts): run it with `bun run test:mutation`, which narrows `mutate` to a shard's files and appends that package's tests to the command. Command runner, not vitest: `bun:test` cannot load under vitest unchanged (see t1-property-mutation report). tsconfigFile points at a name that does not exist so Stryker's TSConfigPreprocessor finds nothing to parse — TS 7's native port dropped `ts.parseConfigFileTextToJson`, which that preprocessor calls unconditionally on any tracked tsconfig.json and crashes on.
